issues.description: About a month ago you closed a ticket that was opened due to gravel/debris following rain.  Yesterday it happened again, when the street flooded.  There are three issues:  the street is again loaded with gravel and rocks, the catch basins can’t handle the water (perhaps needing cleanout) and the source of the debris (a home construction site at the top of the hill which isn’t properly contained).  Perhaps the building department needs to be involved.
